response.justification: The candidate is a poor fit for this role as they lack the core mandatory requirements. Their professional experience is predominantly in web technologies (JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js) and Dlang, not C++. The single professional C++ role mentioned was for a very short duration nearly a decade ago. Furthermore, the candidate has no demonstrated experience in the required financial domains of Capital Markets, Investment Banking, or Fixed Income, and lacks the specified experience on the Windows platform.
strengths: Extensive experience as a senior engineer with a focus on software craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD).
Broad technical background across web, mobile, and embedded systems.
Demonstrated experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD and DevOps infrastructure.
concerns: Critically lacks the required 5-10 years of professional, hands-on C++ experience.
No experience in the mandatory domains of Capital Markets, Fixed Income, or Investment Banking.
Lacks the specified development experience on the Windows platform and with SQL Server/Oracle.
